name: sagemakerjobruntime
description: Agentic RFT Runtime Service - manages trajectory and transition data for reinforcement fine-tuning jobs.

subcommands.name: complete-rollout
subcommands.description: Marks a rollout as complete, indicating that no further turns will be appended to the trajectory.

subcommands.name: sample
subcommands.description: Sends an inference request to the model during a job execution.

subcommands.name: sample-with-response-stream
subcommands.description: Sends a streaming inference request to the model during a job execution.

subcommands.name: update-reward
subcommands.description: Updates the reward values for a trajectory and transitions it to reward-received status, signaling that it is eligible for processing.
